content.text: Lots of 5-year-olds still co-sleep, and he's old enough to be part of the plan. Tonight, start in his own room. Do a short bedtime routine, then tell him you'll sit on a chair by his bed until he's drowsy. Each night after that, move the chair a little closer to the door. Keep the steps small and the same every night. If he comes to find you, walk him back calmly and say very little.
